title.narrative: Building Resilience and Addressing Vulnerability to Emergencies (BRAVE), Climate resilience component

description.narrative: Impact: Extremely poor and vulnerable people in Pakistan are more resilient to climate induced risks, shocks and stressesOutcome: Increased capacity and ability of at-risk communities (especially women and extremely poor) to anticipate, adopt to, and absorb the negative impacts of climate induced shocks and stresses

The project aims to increase the capacity and ability of at risk-communities (especially women, elderly, people with disabilities) to better anticipate, adapt to and absorb the negative impacts of climate related hazards and associated risks, shocks and stress. To be achieved through: Development, management and execution of climate-resilient adaptation plans; Supporting at risk households to access transformational income generation opportunities; Leveraging and fundraising from public and private sector for climate adaptation/mitigation action plans; Development of business/knowledge hubs to build resilience of house holds; Capacity enhancement for line departments to integrate climate change adaptation/planning.
